notes: This paper constrains decaying sterile-neutrino dark matter via the mixing angle sin^2(2theta) as a function of DM mass (5-16 keV), not any of the enumerated axion/dark-photon/scalar couplings. The coupling type does not map to the provided enum (sterile neutrino mixing angle). Limits are presented graphically in Fig. 3 (sin^2(2theta) from ~1e-11 to ~1e-13 over 5-16 keV) but no numerical table of the limit curve is provided in the text, so no reliable data points can be extracted. Local DM density assumed 0.29 GeV/cm^3 (NFW).
